page_title: QuotaBar - Codex Usage Tracker for macOS

summary.name: QuotaBar
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, local-first macOS menu bar app that shows your Codex 5-hour and weekly usage limits with reset countdowns.
use_cases: Monitor Codex 5-hour and weekly usage from the menu bar
Get notified before Codex quota runs out
See when Codex usage windows reset
Keep a floating usage HUD on screen
Copy a usage summary to share or log
summary.what_it_does:
QuotaBar is a native SwiftUI app that sits in the macOS menu bar and displays Codex usage for the 5-hour and weekly windows, with reset countdowns. Left-clicking the icon opens a detail panel and right-clicking opens a quick menu; a floating HUD can be toggled with ⌥⌘Q. Optional system notifications alert on quota and reset events. Users can opt in to fetching official OpenAI and GitHub updates, at most once a day, and copy a one-click usage summary that excludes account information. It signs in through the official Codex login flow and does not require an OpenAI API key.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Floating HUD toggled with ⌥⌘Q plus menu bar panel
Local-first: no developer backend, ads, or analytics SDK
Optional opt-in official OpenAI and GitHub update feed, read at most once daily
One-click usage summary copy that excludes account info
caveats: Current release supports only Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later
Release build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so first launch needs manual confirmation via Control-click Open
